message: block_public_policy is false, so this part of S3 Block Public Access is off for the bucket.
fix: Set block_public_policy to true; the four settings are recommended together.
source_section: Blocking public access to your Amazon S3 storage

message: restrict_public_buckets is false, so this part of S3 Block Public Access is off for the bucket.
fix: Set restrict_public_buckets to true; the four settings are recommended together.
source_section: Blocking public access to your Amazon S3 storage

message: No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block in the plan points at this bucket, so this plan sets no Block Public Access setting on it. A setting made on the account or the organization outside this plan is not seen.
fix: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for the bucket with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls and restrict_public_buckets all true.
source_section: Blocking public access to your Amazon S3 storage

message: An ingress rule allows TCP port 22 (SSH) from 0.0.0.0/0, which is the whole internet.
fix: Limit the source to the addresses that need SSH access (a CIDR block of your own, or the security group of a bastion host), or remove the rule.
source_section: [EC2.13] Security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 22

message: An ingress rule allows all protocols and all ports from ::/0, which is the whole internet.
fix: Open only the ports that the service needs, and only to the sources that need them.
source_section: [EC2.18] Security groups should only allow unrestricted incoming traffic for authorized ports

message: An ingress rule allows TCP port 3389 (RDP) from 0.0.0.0/0, which is the whole internet.
fix: Limit the source to the addresses that need RDP access (a CIDR block of your own, or the security group of a bastion host), or remove the rule.
source_section: [EC2.14] Security groups should not allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 3389

message: publicly_accessible is true, so the DB instance is planned as an Internet-facing instance.
fix: Set publicly_accessible to false and reach the database from inside the network.
source_section: [RDS.2] RDS DB Instances should prohibit public access, as determined by the PubliclyAccessible configuration

message: storage_encrypted is false, so the storage of the DB instance is not encrypted at rest.
fix: Set storage_encrypted to true.
source_section: [RDS.3] RDS DB instances should have encryption at-rest enabled

message: encrypted is false, so the volume is planned without encryption at rest.
fix: Set encrypted to true.
source_section: [EC2.3] Attached Amazon EBS volumes should be encrypted at-rest

message: The plan deletes this DB instance, and the data in it goes with it unless it is kept somewhere else. skip_final_snapshot is true on it, so no final snapshot is taken.
fix: Check that the data is saved or no longer needed. To keep the object, remove it from the plan (for example with a removed block or terraform state rm) or set prevent_destroy to true.
source_section: prevent_destroy

message: The plan replaces this volume: it is destroyed and created again, and the data in the old one is lost unless it is kept somewhere else. Terraform gives the reason replace_because_cannot_update.
fix: Check that the data is saved or no longer needed, and look at the attribute that forces the replacement. Set prevent_destroy to true if the object must never be replaced.
source_section: prevent_destroy

message: allow_nested_items_to_be_public is true, so containers in the storage account can be set up for anonymous read access.
fix: Set allow_nested_items_to_be_public to false.
source_page: Microsoft Learn, Remediate anonymous read access to blob data
source_section: Remediate anonymous read access to blob data (Azure Resource Manager deployments)

message: The storage account has public network access enabled and no network rule that denies by default, so its public endpoint answers connections from any network.
fix: Turn public network access off (public_network_access = "Disabled", or public_network_access_enabled = false in the older provider), or add network_rules with default_action = "Deny" and list the networks that need access.
source_page: Microsoft Learn, Azure Storage firewall rules
source_section: Azure Storage firewall rules and network access control

message: min_tls_version is TLS1_0, which is below TLS1_2, the minimum that Microsoft recommends.
fix: Set min_tls_version to TLS1_2.
source_page: Microsoft Learn, Minimum TLS version for a storage account
source_section: Enforce a minimum required version of Transport Layer Security (TLS) for requests to a storage account

message: An inbound rule allows TCP from any source to port 22 (SSH), so SSH is open to the internet.
fix: Limit the source to the addresses that need SSH access, or use just-in-time access, or remove the rule.
source_section: Just-in-time machine access in Microsoft Defender for Cloud

message: An inbound rule allows all protocols from Internet to port 3389 (RDP), so RDP is open to the internet.
fix: Limit the source to the addresses that need RDP access, or use just-in-time access, or remove the rule.
source_section: Just-in-time machine access in Microsoft Defender for Cloud

message: uniform_bucket_level_access is false, so ACLs stay active on the bucket next to IAM.
fix: Set uniform_bucket_level_access to true.
source_section: Should you use uniform bucket-level access?

message: allUsers is granted the role roles/storage.objectViewer on the bucket, so anyone on the internet gets that access.
fix: Grant the role to the identities that need it (users, groups or service accounts), and not to a special identifier for everyone.
source_section: allUsers

message: members is not known until apply, so the check on it was not made and nothing was guessed.
fix: Make the value one that Terraform can know at plan time, or review it by hand after apply.
source_section: Change Representation

message: The firewall rule allows ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, which is any IPv4 address, to TCP port 22 (SSH).
fix: Limit source_ranges to the addresses that need SSH access, or reach the machines through a proxy such as Identity-Aware Proxy, or remove the rule.
source_page: Google Cloud, Security Command Center vulnerability findings
source_section: Open SSH port
